mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy cycle, lowering discount rates on equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in <60% of triggered instances during monetary easing, or discount rate impact model shows no correlation with returns.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in GDP exceeding 17,000 Billions Chained 2017 Dollars signals robust demand growth, prompting market optimism and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20d returns not statistically positive (p >0.05) despite GDPC1 crossing threshold, or GDP growth decelerates post-trigger.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in both demand (GDP) and supply (industrial production) indicators signals a balanced economic expansion, enhancing corporate earnings expectations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: both GDPC1 and INDPRO increase sequentially over 3 months
failure_condition: Interaction effect not statistically significant (p >0.05) in 60d returns, or supply-demand imbalance persists despite both proxies rising.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime characterized by low unemployment and loose monetary policy (FEDFUNDS <1.5%), the combination of low inflation (UNRATE <4%) and accommodative monetary conditions fosters market optimism, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60d returns not significantly positive (p >0.05) despite meeting trigger conditions, or FEDFUNDS rises above 1.5% during the period.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden rise in the federal funds rate above 1.5% signals aggressive monetary tightening, raising borrowing costs and dampening equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20d returns not significantly negative (p >0.05) during the period of FEDFUNDS above 1.5%, or discount rate impact model shows no correlation.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above 105.2 (current level at t-1mo) signals robust supply-side growth, boosting corporate profits and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5d returns not significantly positive (p >0.05) during the period of INDPRO increase, or supply growth decelerates post-trigger.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in GDP demand (GDPC1) and labor participation (PAYEMS) indicates a robust economic expansion, enhancing investor confidence and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: both GDPC1 and PAYEMS increase sequentially over 2 months
failure_condition: Interaction effect not statistically significant (p >0.05) in 20d returns, or demand-labor growth decouples post-trigger.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 5.0% signals labor market weakening, reducing growth prospects and prompting negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60d returns not significantly negative (p >0.05) despite UNRATE falling below 5%, or unemployment rate recovers post-trigger.
